definitions.deltaRadius: def deltaRadius (k n : Nat) (epsilon : Rat) : Rat := epsilon/(8*2^(n+1)*lipschitzQ k)
definitions.allocatedRadius: def allocatedRadius (k n : Nat) (L epsilon : Rat) : Rat := logRadius L (deltaRadius k n epsilon)

theorem deltaRadius_positive (k n : Nat) (epsilon : Rat) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) : 0 < deltaRadius k n epsilon
theorem allocatedRadius_positive (k n : Nat) (L epsilon : Rat) (hL : 0 < L) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) : 0 < allocatedRadius k n L epsilon
theorem allocatedRadius_error (k n : Nat) (L epsilon : Rat) (hL : 0 < L) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) : |(allocatedRadius k n L epsilon : Real)-Real.pi*(L : Real)| <= (deltaRadius k n epsilon : Real)
